designContextPolicy: creator-confirmed snapshot from the common comparison brief; loaded instructions, then .impeccable.md, then AI-DLC questions through bounded teach-impeccable; never infer from code and never write AGENTS.md

impeccable-historical.label: Arm C pinned historical Impeccable frontend-design (default; the only choice in ui-poc-comparison)

impeccable.label: Impeccable 4.6.0 (latest at pin): shape/new-work, craft floor, critique, polish
impeccable.adapter: Bounded adapter, not full upstream execution: never run scripts/impeccable, its hooks, live mode, or pin (the launcher downloads and runs a binary); take the skill's 'Launcher unavailable' path with the creator-confirmed Design Context snapshot as the PRODUCT.md-equivalent context and do not write PRODUCT.md or DESIGN.md. The surface is Operate mode. Choose the visual world through new-work, read craft-floor immediately before writing the HTML, then render every declared state, critique the screenshots with critique.md, and apply polish.md; fix what one look shows before looking again. The brief wins over the skill's taste. AI-DLC owns files, stable screen/state/AC IDs, the refined contract, and approval.

ui-ux-pro-max.label: UI/UX Pro Max: local design-system search (styles, palettes, type pairings, UX rules)
ui-ux-pro-max.adapter: Bounded adapter, not full upstream execution: run only the local search `python3 .agents/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py "<product type> <2-5 keywords>" --design-system` plus targeted --domain queries; never pass --persist or --force and write nothing outside this stage's record. Search results are recommendations: the creator-confirmed brief (tone, light/dark, motion, no external requests) wins, so drop any palette, font import, or effect it contradicts. Record the adopted pattern, palette, type, and effects in design-system-mapping.md, then check the rendered HTML against pro-rules.md's pre-delivery checklist. AI-DLC owns files, stable screen/state/AC IDs, the refined contract, and approval.

ponta-pass-design.label: Pontaパス design system (Web/Android/iOS): tokens, components, templates, and bundled assets from the existing screens; installed from a local copy
ponta-pass-design.adapter: Bounded adapter, not full upstream execution: follow SKILL.md steps 1-8 inside this stage. Choose the platform (web, android, or ios) and, for Web, the style F1-F14 from the creator-confirmed brief and approved requirements; when they leave it open, ask through AI-DLC's pending-question flow, never a separate prompt. Then read only the matching references/<platform>.md. Build from the skill's templates, components, CSS-variable tokens chosen by role, and bundled images; never redraw logos or characters, and use the skill's image placeholder for any image it does not bundle. Check every refined HTML with `python3 -I .agents/skills/ponta-pass-design/scripts/check.py --strict <platform> <html>` and fix each value not found in the existing screens, or list it as 既存に無い値. Before step 2, on every run of this stage, ask the person through AI-DLC's pending-question flow for the absolute path of their folder of original Pontaパス screens (the exported design HTML; where it lives and what it is called differ per person), with two choices: give the folder (recommended), or continue without it. Never take the folder from PONTA_PASS_EXPORT, the skill's default ~/Downloads folder, or an earlier run without asking. Accept the path only when it is an existing directory and `python3 -I .agents/skills/ponta-pass-design/scripts/ref.py list <folder>` lists at least one screen; otherwise say why in one line and ask again. Pass the folder as ref.py's first argument on every call (ref.py silently falls back to its default folder when that argument is not a directory), and write `ref.py render` output only inside this stage's record. When the person continues without the folder, state that steps 2 and 7 were skipped. Record which screens were read, never the folder path. Make each refined HTML self-contained with `python3 -I .agents/skills/ponta-pass-design/scripts/bundle.py <in> <out>`; no request leaves the file and nothing is written outside this stage's record. Record the reference screen IDs, the platform and style, the check result, and the 既存に無い値 list in the stage's design notes. The creator-confirmed brief wins where it conflicts with the skill; record the conflict. AI-DLC owns files, stable screen/state/AC IDs, the refined contract, and approval.

rough-mockups.adapter: Use AI-DLC's existing question mechanism only. Do not infer creator context from code, create a separate approval, or edit AGENTS.md. Stop until audience, use cases, and brand tone are creator-confirmed.

Bounded adapter, not full upstream execution: borrow single-surface variant switching to generate low-fidelity, self-contained, read-only structural alternatives; AI-DLC owns files and approval; no production polish or throwaway branch operation.

Apply the historical Impeccable component while preserving rough low fidelity. Read all seven bundled references. Override only the erroneous large-text threshold through the declared WCAG adapter: 24 CSS px normal or 18.6667 CSS px bold; keep pinned bytes unchanged.
Bounded adapter, not full upstream execution: one question only; no production code, persistence, tests, branch manipulation, or approval.

requirements-analysis.adapter: Use only inside AI-DLC Steps 6-8; AI-DLC pending-question flow asks and records answers; do not ask twice or request a separate confirmation.
Terminology and domain boundaries only; do not pre-decide types, validation, allowed values, cardinality, or implementation.

refined-mockups.adapter: Refine against approved requirements and stable screen/state/AC IDs; use the same confirmed brief as A/B; ordinary AI-DLC approval remains authoritative. Apply the declared WCAG large-text correction.
Only unresolved visual choices; no new route by default, no branch manipulation, and no claim of approval.

domain-design.adapter: Entity ownership, canonical language, boundaries, and qualifying ADR candidates only; core domain-design artifacts and approval own the decision.

code-generation.adapter: Implement approved refined HTML faithfully. Do not reopen aesthetic decisions, run a new context interview, alter the Testing Contract, or inherit prototype no-tests guidance. Apply the declared WCAG large-text correction; production tests remain mandatory.
